Greetings, Agents! 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Another Super Hero has come to aid 
the New Guardians of the Galaxy to fight against the extraterrestrial threat!

 

Additional May Update!
We will introduce a new look and an ultimate skill for <Silver Surfer>, the herald of Galactus!
Log in to MARVEL Future Fight after the 6/10 patch, and complete missions with Silver Surfer!

 

[6/10 3:18 a.m. (UTC+0) / 6/9 8:18 p.m. (PDT) Added]

The patch has been completed. Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

■ 6/10 Patch Details 
Patch Schedule:  6/10 2:00 a.m. (UTC+0) / 6/9 7:00 p.m. (PDT)
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the patch application time may vary.
* The game can be played during the patch, 
but we recommend our Agents to reconnect to the game to apply the patch.

 

▣ New Silver Surfer <Black> Uniform
 

* The new Uniform will be available for purchase after the 6/10 patch 
 and will be on sale for a discount price during the event.
* The new Uniform will be on sale during the event and will be available for purchase in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

 


▣ Silver Surfer Tier-3 

 

 

 

▣ Other Information

 

1. Nova (Richard Rider)’s skill “Chain Explosion Smash” will be able to penetrate “Guard Break Immune” effect.
2. An issue where Silver Surfer’s board is displayed in different colors has been fixed.
3. An issue where the type of Gladiator, who appears as a villain in -Fate of the Universe- United Against the Dark stage from Epic Quest: The Galactic Imperative, is applied as Universal has been fixed.
4. An issue where Agent Level does not increase after advancing Tier-2 Star-Lord to Tier-3 through Epic Quest: The Galactic Imperative has been fixed.

[6/15 1:54 a.m. (UTC+0) / 6/14 6:54 p.m. Added]

- Agent Level has also increased for those Agents who already had acquired Tier-3 Star-Lord before the 6/10 patch.

 

Don’t forget to check out the various new events!

 

Thank you.
